note: bamboo_twig_file (submodule of bamboo_twig) registers on service bamboo_twig_file.twig.file: function bamboo_file_url_absolute(uri) -> file_url_generator->generateAbsoluteString(uri) (already-absolute or root-relative strings pass through; FALSE if no wrapper), and filter bamboo_file_extension_guesser -> best-guess extension for a MIME type via Symfony MimeTypes (or null). Medium cases are live introspection (extension for application/pdf, text/plain). Hard cases have the agent write a Twig template (under web/sites/default/files/) rendered by verify: guess pdf from application/pdf, and absolute URL for public://bamboo_file_probe.txt.

evals.prompt: Which bamboo_twig_file function turns a stream URI like public://logo.png into an absolute URL in a Twig template, and what does it do if the string is already absolute?
evals.expected_output: bamboo_file_url_absolute(uri) returns an absolute URL via the file URL generator; strings already starting with http/https/'/' are returned unchanged, and it returns FALSE if no stream wrapper matches.

evals.prompt: How do I guess a file extension from a MIME type in a Twig template with bamboo_twig_file?
evals.expected_output: Use the filter, e.g. {{ 'image/png' | bamboo_file_extension_guesser }} -> png (or null if none could be guessed).

evals.prompt: In bamboo_twig_file, which of its two helpers is a Twig filter and which is a Twig function?
evals.expected_output: bamboo_file_extension_guesser is a filter (mime | bamboo_file_extension_guesser); bamboo_file_url_absolute is a function (bamboo_file_url_absolute(uri)).

evals.prompt: On this live Drupal site, what extension does bamboo_file_extension_guesser return for the MIME type 'application/pdf'? Confirm by running it on the site.
On this live site, what extension does bamboo_file_extension_guesser return for the MIME type 'text/plain'?
Using bamboo_twig_file, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_file_render_ext.html.twig whose rendered output is the guessed file extension for the MIME type application/pdf.
evals.expected_output: Write {{ 'application/pdf' | bamboo_file_extension_guesser }}; rendered output is pdf.

evals.prompt: Using bamboo_twig_file, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_file_render_url.html.twig whose rendered output is the absolute URL for the stream URI public://bamboo_file_probe.txt.
evals.expected_output: Write {{ bamboo_file_url_absolute('public://bamboo_file_probe.txt') }}; rendered output is an absolute URL containing sites/default/files/bamboo_file_probe.txt.
